subject: Provisional credit request for HelixCare — multimodel private delay
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Provisional credit request for HelixCare — multimodel private delay

Team,

Quick summary: HelixCare flagged a hard stop on our Private multimodel rollout (their main use case is multi-model routing to assemble outputs across specialized models). They were expecting the private-quantized multimodel variant by end of August to meet their go-live; we've confirmed a regression in the quant kernel and the private release is slipping ~6 weeks.

Impact to HelixCare: they have a customer-facing launch scheduled for 9/15; they're now telling their execs we missed a hard milestone and are asking for commercial remediation while we fix the release. Aditya is already in daily sync with the customer (see attached issue log).

Ask: can we approve a provisional commercial accommodation (credit or discount) while product confirms an exact delivery date? Ideally we'd provide a limited bridge credit to avoid churn and buy time for delivery. I don't want us to escalate without a quick internal alignment — can product confirm the realistic ETA and whether there is a technical mitigation (e.g., enabling prefetch/pinned cache on their Dedicated pool) we can offer immediately? Finance, can you sketch acceptable ranges for a provisional credit we can offer without pre-approval?

Attachments: helixcare_issue_log.pdf (customer tickets & error traces), proposed-map-helixcare.xlsx (Aditya's proposed mutual action plan).

Next steps I recommend:
- Product: confirm ETA + short-term mitigation options (prefetch / cache pin / temporary capacity mapping) by EOD today.
- Sales: consolidate churn risk and recommended $ amount (or % of committed spend) — include expected timeline to sign MAP.
- Finance: provide guardrails for provisional credit (max $ / % and required conditions).

Irene
Irene Choi
Account Lead, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisional credit request for HelixCare — multimodel private delay

On Tue, Aug 11, 2026 at 9:12 AM Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team,
> 
> Quick summary: HelixCare flagged a hard stop on our Private multimodel rollout...

Thanks for the heads up, Irene — I dug into the engineering notes. Short version: a regression in the int8 quant kernel surfaced during private-package validation when the multimodel routing path uses large KV cache sequences; that surfaced only in the private build because of a different loader path. We're estimating ~6 weeks to fully validate and release a private-compatible, quantized multimodel package (best estimate: 2026-09-24) unless we push a reduce-risk patch.

Mitigations I can offer immediately:
- Temporary Dedicated mapping: spin up a dedicated non-quantized variant of the models for HelixCare on our hosted pool (same API surface) — buys time but increases unit cost and token latency slightly.
- Prefetch/KV pin: enable aggressive KV prefix caching for their routes; reduces token cost and should resolve most of their immediate failures in the short term (engineering notes attached in helixcare_issue_log.pdf).

I agree a commercial bridge makes sense if HelixCare signs a MAP committing to the updated timeline and testing milestones. If Finance can give a provisional ceiling, I think Product can support the Dedicated mapping for 4–6 weeks while we finish the quant work.

I'll coordinate with infra to estimate the cost delta for the Dedicated mapping and confirm the earliest rollback path.

Laura Bennett
Head of Product, Redwood Inference

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sarah Lin <sarah.lin@helixcare.com>, David Chen <david.chen@helixcare.com>, contracts@helixcare.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisional credit request for HelixCare — multimodel private delay

Folks — copying the customer so we're aligned on transparency.

Context from HelixCare: they are mid-POC with a major payer partner; if we can't meet a path to the private multimodel experience they may pause our committed expansion and re-evaluate alternatives. We are at elevated churn risk.

Commercial ask (sales recommendation):
- One-time provisional credit equal to 25% of committed monthly spend, applied for two billing cycles (or up to $60k total), contingent on signed MAP within 72 hours that includes acceptance criteria and telemetry hooks.
- If product can enact the Dedicated mapping + KV pin immediately, reduce to 15% for two cycles.

Proposed MAP highlights (attached):
- 8/13: enable KV pin & start dedicated mapping for HelixCare
- 8/20: integration smoke tests (customer)
- 9/10: acceptance test pass window
- 9/24: private-quantized multimodel release

Aditya
Sr Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, irene_choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 17:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Provisional credit request for HelixCare — multimodel private delay

Thanks for laying this out. Finance has reviewed the customer history and deal economics for HC-DEAL-3821. We are prepared to approve a conditional, provisional commercial accommodation to de-risk the account, with the following conditions: 

1) Provisional credit: up to $45,000 total (or 20% of committed monthly spend, whichever is lower), applied as a billing credit across the next two invoices.
2) Conditions for credit disbursement:
   - Signed Mutual Action Plan (MAP) within 48 hours of this email.
   - Telemetry and acceptance tests enabled (email evidence) within 7 calendar days of MAP signature.
   - Product to confirm Dedicated mapping availability and commence KV pin by 8/13.
3) If product misses the 9/24 delivery without a validated rollback plan, Finance reserves the right to convert the provisional credit into a committed concession (legal amendment) or withhold further commercial flexibility.
4) Legal to prepare a short amendment documenting the credit terms and MOP; draft attached: legal-amendment-draft.docx. Contracts should route to HelixCare contracts@helixcare.com for signature.

Marissa Cole
VP, Revenue Operations & Finance
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

[Attached: legal-amendment-draft.docx]
